test_title: PYST 41: SSC GD Constable 2025 - English (Held On: 25 Feb, 2025 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Atul lit the candle with a __match__. 'Match' here means __________________.

options.text: a piece of decorative or protective material placed on the tip of a stick
a contest in a game or sport
a short stick with a tip that ignites when rubbed on a rough surface

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"match"** in this context refers to a short stick with a tip that ignites when rubbed on a rough surface. (माचिस की तिल्ली) • **Example:** He struck a match to light the candle during the power outage. • The word **"match"** has various meanings, but in the given sentence, it clearly refers to the object used to create fire. (माचिस की तिल्ली) • **Example:** She used a match to ignite the stove for cooking dinner. • Hence, the correct interpretation of "match" in this context aligns with Option 4. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: A piece of stone** (पत्थर का टुकड़ा): Refers to a fragment of stone material. • **Example:** He found a small piece of stone on the hiking trail. • **Option 2: A piece of decorative or protective material placed on the tip of a stick** (सजावटी या सुरक्षात्मक सामग्री का टुकड़ा): Refers to an ornamental or protective covering on a stick. • **Example:** The walking stick had a decorative piece at the tip. • **Option 3: A contest in a game or sport** (खेल या खेल में प्रतियोगिता): Refers to a competitive event between players or teams. • **Example:** The cricket match was thrilling and kept the audience on edge. 31:T992, The correct answer is** option 4.**
